intro: Yellowstone is the region on this site where a radio is closest to genuinely necessary. There is effectively no cell coverage away from the villages, distances between services are enormous, and the Park Service runs an extensive analog VHF repeater network that will tell you about a road closure, a bison jam or a rescue long before you would find out any other way. Bring the federal band and a spare battery.
introz: 黄石是本站所有地区中最接近“真的需要电台”的地方。离开村镇基本没有手机信号，服务点之间距离极远，而国家公园局运营着一套覆盖广泛的模拟 VHF 中继网络——封路、野牛堵车、救援，你会比通过任何其他途径都更早知道。记得带上联邦波段和备用电池。

stations.z: 黄石国家公园局主业务频率
stations.d: Ranger dispatch for the whole park, relayed through repeaters on Mount Washburn and other high points so it covers a remarkable area. Road status, wildlife jams, medicals and law enforcement. Exact channels shift — scan 162–174 MHz in NFM on arrival and save what is busy.
stations.dz: 覆盖全园的护林员调度，通过 Washburn 山等高点中继转发，覆盖范围相当大。内容包括路况、野生动物堵车、医疗和执法。具体频率会变——到园后用 NFM 扫 162–174 MHz，把活跃的存下来。

stations.d: Climbing rangers on the Grand run some of the most technical rescues in the country, coordinated on this band.
stations.dz: 大提顿峰的攀登护林员在这个波段协调全美最具技术难度的救援之一。

stations.d: Helicopter medevac and fire aviation. In the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem this band is busy all summer.
stations.dz: 直升机医疗后送与消防航空。整个夏季，大黄石生态区的这个波段都很忙。

stations.d: Surrounding national forests, where most of the backcountry actually is.
stations.dz: 周边国家森林——大部分荒野其实都在这里。

stations.d: Seasonal field just outside the west entrance. Also a smokejumper base.
stations.dz: 西入口外的季节性机场，同时也是伞降消防员基地。

stations.d: The only commercial airport inside a US national park. Approaches thread between the Tetons and the Gros Ventre — worth listening to on a windy day.
stations.dz: 美国唯一位于国家公园内的商用机场。进近要在提顿山和 Gros Ventre 山之间穿行，大风天很值得听。

stations.d: Wildlife survey flights, fire recon and scenic operations.
stations.dz: 野生动物调查飞行、火情侦察和观光作业。

stations.z: 盐湖城区域管制（黄石扇区）
stations.d: From a high point like Mount Washburn you will hear airliners at cruise from hundreds of miles away.
stations.dz: 在 Washburn 山这样的高点，能听到数百英里外巡航中的客机。

stations.d: Weather here turns fast and violently in every season. Coverage inside the caldera is imperfect — try from Dunraven Pass or Lake Butte Overlook.
stations.dz: 这里的天气四季都变得又快又猛。破火山口内部覆盖不完整——可在 Dunraven 山口或 Lake Butte 观景点尝试。

stations.d: Repeater coverage is thin here, so simplex from a high point is your realistic option. Mount Washburn, Dunraven Pass and Signal Mountain all work well.
stations.dz: 这里中继覆盖稀疏，从高点直通才是现实选择。Washburn 山、Dunraven 山口和 Signal 山都不错。

stations.d: Confirm against RepeaterBook for Teton and Park counties before relying on it.
stations.dz: 依赖前请在 RepeaterBook 查 Teton 县和 Park 县确认。

stations.z: 黄石旅客信息台 · 中波
stations.d: Low-power AM loops at every park entrance covering road construction, closures and safety warnings. This is genuinely the most practical broadcast in the park and your VX-6 tunes down far enough to receive it. Watch for the roadside signs, which give the exact frequency.
stations.dz: 每个公园入口都有小功率中波循环播报，内容包括道路施工、封闭和安全警示。这是园内最实用的广播，而 VX-6 的调谐下限足够低，能收到。注意路边指示牌，上面写明具体频率。

stations.d: Based in Billings with a network of translators across Montana and northern Wyoming. Sweep 88–92 MHz to find the nearest one.
stations.dz: 总部在 Billings，通过遍布蒙大拿和怀俄明北部的转播台覆盖。在 88–92 MHz 扫一遍找最近的。

stations.z: MURS · 园内特许经营方作业
stations.d: Lodges, snowcoach operators, guide services and construction crews use license-free MURS and FRS heavily inside the park.
stations.dz: 园内旅馆、雪地车运营方、向导公司和施工队大量使用免执照 MURS 与 FRS。

stations.z: FRS 1 频道 · 游客与向导

stations.d: County sheriff and mutual aid across Park, Teton and Gallatin counties.
stations.dz: Park、Teton 和 Gallatin 三县的县警与互助通信。

stations.d: North of the park along the Yellowstone River. Scan 160.215–161.565.
Almost no RF noise floor out here. Satellite reception is far better than in any city.
stations.dz: 这里几乎没有射频底噪，卫星接收比任何城市都好得多。

stations.d: Colorado is close by, so this comes in strongly day and night.
stations.dz: 距科罗拉多不远，昼夜信号都很强。
